Escuta: fala rápida e redução das vogais: Listening: fast speech and vowel reduction
Entender o russo falado: a redução das v: Understand spoken Russian: the reduction of unstressed vowels (о → а, е → и), consonant assimilation, contractions of informal speech (щас, чего, здрасте) and intonation, and practice with sentences you hear.
PASSO 1: no russo, a SÍLABA TÔNICA é for: STEP 1: in Russian the STRESSED syllable is strong and the UNSTRESSED ones weaken: this is REDUCTION. STEP 2: unstressed «О» sounds like «А»: «молоко» [ma-la-KOH], «хорошо» [kha-ra-SHOH], «вода» [va-DAH]. STEP 3: unstressed «Е» and «Я» sound like «И»: «сестра» [sis-TRAH], «язык» [yi-ZIK], «весна» [vyis-NAH]. STEP 4: the «Г» in «его, сегодня, чего» sounds like «В»: «его» [yi-VOH], «сегодня» [si-VOD-nya]. STEP 5: «ЧТО» sounds [SHTOH] and «КОНЕЧНО» sounds [ka-NYESH-na]. STEP 6: «ЗДРАВСТВУЙТЕ» has a silent «В»: [ZDRAH-stvooy-tyeh]. STEP 7: voiced consonants at the end of a word become unvoiced: «хлеб» [khlyep], «год» [goht]. STEP 8: the written text does NOT show the reduction: that is why listening a lot is essential.
o português também reduz vogais átonas (: English also reduces unstressed vowels (the first "a" in "about" and the last "a" in "sofa" are a weak "uh"), but Russian reduces more regularly: an unstressed «о» becomes a short "ah".

PASSO 1: na fala rápida e informal, as p: STEP 1: in fast, informal speech, words get SHORTER: «сейчас» becomes «щас», «здравствуйте» becomes «здрасте», «пожалуйста» is said [pa-ZHAL-sta], «сколько» sounds [SKOL-ka]. STEP 2: «ЧЕГО» takes the place of «почему» or «что»: «Ты чего не пришёл?» (why didn't you come?). STEP 3: «ДАВАЙ» and «ЛАДНО» are short replies: «Давай!» (let's / OK), «Ладно!» (fine). STEP 4: «НУ ТЫ ДАЁШЬ!» is an exclamation of astonishment ("you're something else!"). STEP 5: use these forms ONLY with friends; at work and in formal writing, use the full forms. STEP 6: intonation shows emotion: a question goes up, a statement goes down. English does the same with "gonna", "wanna" and "y'all"; they are fine among friends but not in a letter.
Щас вы можете начать? (a um chefe): Щас вы можете начать? (to a boss)
In formal writing, use the full form.

Ouvir uma conversa de amigos: Listening to a conversation between friends
PASSO 1: ouça primeiro o RITMO e a ENTON: STEP 1: first listen to the RHYTHM and the INTONATION, not word by word. STEP 2: recognise the LINKING words: «ну, же, ведь, вот, ладно». STEP 3: recognise the REDUCTIONS: «щас, здрасте». STEP 4: use the CONTEXT: the lateness, the football, the request to hurry. STEP 5: then repeat the sentences, imitating the intonation.
Ora essa! Eu já disse!: Well, how about that! I did say so!
Dois amigos esperam por um terceiro para: Two friends are waiting for a third one for a game.
— Ora essa! Eu já disse que iria me atra: — Oh, come on! I already told you I'd be late.
— Você é demais! Esperamos você uma hora: — You're unbelievable! We waited for you a whole hour.
— Sorry, the traffic was awful. I'll be there in a minute.
— Tá bem, vem logo. Hoje tem futebol, af: — All right, hurry up. After all, there's football today.
— Eu sei, eu sei. Já estou correndo!: — I know, I know. I'm already running!
